chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from one of his companions, who said:
I said to Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام: A man hastens ahead of al-Tarwiyah by one day or two because of the crowding and the pressure of the people. So he said: There is no harm.

key_terms.التَّرْوِيَةِ: the Day of Tarwiyah in the hajj rites
key_terms.ضِغَاطِ: pressure and compression caused by the crowd
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.يَتَعَجَّلُ: to hasten or go ahead earlier than usual

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to go to Minā one or two days before the Day of Tarwiyah because of crowding?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning departure to Minā before the Day of Tarwiyah. Imam Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام permits leaving one or two days early due to crowding and the pressure of people.
